chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: O. P. Ramaswamy Reddiyar
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Passed the Madras Temple Entry Authorization Act 1947, giving Dalits and other marginalized communities the legal right to enter Hindu temples.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: P. S. Kumaraswamy Raja
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Initiated the historic separation of the Judiciary from the Executive branch in the state's administration.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: C. Rajagopalachari
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Removed controls on food grains to successfully curb the black market and alleviate food scarcity issues.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: K. Kamaraj
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Introduced the revolutionary free Mid-Day Meal Scheme in government schools, drastically increasing school enrollment and reducing dropout rates among the poor.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: M. Bhakthavatsalam
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Spearheaded the establishment of several vital industrial estates and major irrigation projects across the state.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: C. N. Annadurai
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Officially renamed 'Madras State' to 'Tamil Nadu' and legalized 'Self-Respect Marriages' which did not require a Brahmin priest to officiate.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: M. Karunanidhi
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Established the 'Uzhavar Santhai' (Farmers' Market) to eliminate middlemen, and introduced free electricity for agricultural farmers.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: M. G. Ramachandran
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Upgraded the Mid-Day Meal Scheme into the 'Nutritious Meal Scheme', significantly improving child health and continuing to boost rural literacy.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: Janaki Ramachandran
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Ensured the continuity of the state government administration and welfare schemes immediately following M. G. Ramachandran's sudden passing.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: J. Jayalalithaa
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Introduced the 'Cradle Baby Scheme' to combat female infanticide and launched the highly successful subsidized 'Amma Canteens'.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: O. Panneerselvam
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Passed an emergency ordinance in 2017 to legalize and ensure the uninterrupted conduct of the traditional 'Jallikattu' sport after widespread statewide protests.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: Edappadi K. Palaniswami
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.party_name: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK)
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Implemented a 7.5% horizontal reservation in medical colleges for government school students who clear the NEET exam.

chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.name: M. K. Stalin
chief_ministers_tamil_nadu.notable_decision: Launched the 'Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam', a scheme providing a monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to eligible women heads of families.
